en: Black-and-white image showing a formal civic-style building and an adjoining structure with an arcade of arches. The main building is three stories high, covered with ivy, and topped with a steep, dark gabled roof with dormer-like windows. In front, a row of evenly planted trees lines an open paved square or courtyard. The adjacent lower building at right has a tiled roof and a colonnade with rounded arches forming a covered walkway. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
